names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 8 februarie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 8 Φεβρουαρίου, «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Στρατηλάτης», with the rank word and the epithet left off.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 8 февраля ст. ст., «Великомученик Феодор Стратилат», with the rank word left off; «Стратилат» is the calendar's own by-name for his command and is kept with the name.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 8. јун ст. ст., „Свети великомученик Теодор Стратилат“, which prints the identical string the 8 February heading printed. Свети is not a rank and великомученик is the `great-martyr` this corpus puts in `types`; Стратилат is the by-name the display name itself carries and is kept. **THIS IS THE FOLDER’S FIRST `sr` FORM**: the reader of the Julian 8 February quoted that heading into the attestation and stored no Serbian form, so the folder has carried `ro`, `el` and `ru` only. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so it raises no fold although the corpus holds five other Стратилат folders.

hymns.text: Strălucit voievod al adevăratei Oşti a Împăratului Ceresc ai ajuns, Fericite Teodor, purtătorule de biruinţă; că înţelepţeşte te-ai luptat cu armele credinţei şi mulţimile demonilor le-ai biruit şi adevărat biruitor te-ai arătat. Pentru aceasta pe tine cu credinţă pururea te fericim.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Mare Mucenic Teodor Stratilat, Glasul 4

english.text: A shining commander of the true army of the Heavenly King thou hast become, O blessed Theodore, bearer of victory; for thou didst fight wisely with the weapons of the faith, and didst overcome the multitudes of the demons, and wast shown a true victor. Therefore we ever call thee blessed with faith.

hymns.text: Στρατολογία ἀληθεῖ Ἀθλοφόρε, τοῦ οὐρανίου στρατηγὸς βασιλέως, περικαλλὴς γεγένησαι Θεόδωρε, ὄπλοις γὰρ τῆς πίστεως, παρετάξω ἐμφρόνως, καὶ κατεξωλόθρευσας, τῶν δαιμόνων τὰ στίφη, καὶ νικηφόρος ὤφθης Ἀθλητής, ὅθεν σὲ πίστει, ἀεὶ μακαρίζαμεν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Στρατηλάτης, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Ἀπολυτίκιον

english.text: By a true enlistment, prize-bearer, you became the all-beautiful general of the heavenly king, Theodore; for you drew up your line prudently with the weapons of the faith, and utterly destroyed the throngs of the demons, and were shown a victorious contender — and therefore we call you blessed in faith for ever.

hymns.text: Ἀνδρεία ψυχῆς, τὴν πίστιν ὀπλισάμενος, καὶ ρῆμα Θεοῦ, ὡς λόγχην χειρισάμενος, τὸν ἐχθρὸν κατέτρωσας τῶν Μαρτύρων κλέος Θεόδωρε, σὺν αὐτοὶς Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, πρεσβεύων μὴ παύση ὑπὲρ πάντων ἠμῶν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr) — Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Στρατηλάτης, Λειτουργικά κείμενα: Κοντάκιον

english.text: Having armed the faith with courage of soul, and wielded the word of God as a spear, you wounded the enemy, Theodore, glory of the martyrs; with them do not cease to intercede with Christ our God for us all.

hymns.text: Мужеством души в веру оболкийся/ и глагол Божий, аки копие, в руку взем,/ врага победил еси,/ мучеников превелий Феодоре,// с ними Христу Богу моляся не престай о всех нас.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 февраля ст. ст. — «Кондак великомученика Феодора»

english.text: Having clothed thyself in the faith by the courage of thy soul, and having taken the word of God in thy hand as a spear, thou didst overcome the enemy, O Theodore, greatest of martyrs. Cease not to pray with them to Christ God for us all.

feast.note: The same calendar prints him a second time, on the Julian 8 июня, and the line there reads like a memory and not like a translation: «Вмч. Феодора Стратилата (319).», with the same year 319 this row's February line gives and no word of the relics in it. The site itself says what the day is elsewhere: name page 2201 lists «Дни памяти: 8 февраля , 8 июня» and its «Жития» block carries three readings, the second headed «Перенесение мощей вликомученика Феодора Стратилата» — the page's own spelling of великомученика, quoted as printed — so this calendar makes the June day the translation of the relics even where its day line does not. That agrees with the Greek row's note and with the Serbian row's, and this folder's life already sets out the two sources that send the relics in opposite directions. One row per church is the schema, so the June day is recorded here and he does not render on it; the row it sits in is this folder's own bytes, loaded out of the file and copied back with nothing but this note added. The 8 июня day page prints «Тропарь великомученика Феодора» глас 4 and «Кондак великомученика Феодора» глас 2 over him; the kontakion is word for word the one this folder already holds from 8 февраля and differs from it in one mark only, the February page breaking the line after «в руку взем,» where the June page runs on, which was checked by comparing the two strings and not by eye; and the troparion was not copied, because the row that would carry it stands on another day. Read 8 October 2026.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 8 февраля ст. ст. — «Вмч. Феодора Стратилата (319).»
Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 februarie — «Sfântul Mare Mucenic Teodor Stratilat»

feast.note: saint.gr's page for him adds a second Greek day, and names it as a translation and not as his memory: «Το σεπτό σκήνωμά του μετετέθη, στις 8 Ιουνίου, από την Ηρακλεία στο προγονικό κτήμα του Αγίου, στα Ευχάιτα… Η Εκκλησία μας εορτάζει στις 8 Ιουνίου την ανακομιδή των λειψάνων του» — his body was moved on 8 June from Herakleia to his ancestral estate at Euchaita, and the Church keeps the translation of his relics on 8 June (https://www.saint.gr/536/saint.aspx, read 30 September 2026). The 8 June Greek day page was not read, and the day recorded here is the day page that was.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Στρατηλάτης»

Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.02.2026 (8. фебруар ст. ст.) — „1. Свети великомученик Теодор Стратилат. … Пострада свети Теодор 8. фебруара 319. године у три часа по подне, и пресели се у царство Христово. Он се сматра заштитником војника који га призивају у помоћ.“

attestations.note: Read from the Prologue text on the page, not from its entry list; he is its first numbered entry and the list printed his heading. Four things stand only here: the hour, three in the afternoon; the count of the lashes, six hundred on the back and five hundred on the belly; that he broke the idols of silver and gold and shared the pieces out among the poor; and that he is held the protector of soldiers who call on him for help. The year is 319, which is also the Russian line’s «(319)» and is not saint.gr’s 320; dates.death now holds the interval between the two readings, where it had held saint.gr’s alone although the Russian figure was already cited on this folder. The Prologue also sends his relics the other way from the Greek page: from Euchaita to Constantinople and the church of the Blachernae, where saint.gr moves them on 8 June from Herakleia to Euchaita. Neither is preferred. — A SECOND DAY ON THIS CHURCH, ADDED 5 October 2026. **THIS WOULD HAVE BEEN §4’S FIFTH REFUSAL AND IT IS NOT, FOR ONE REASON: THE ROW WAS ALREADY VENERATED.** The Julian 8 June entry is a translation of relics and says so in its own first sentence — „Овај светитељ празнује се (в. 8. фебруар), и тамо је његово житије описано, а 8. јуна пак празнује се пренос моштију његових из Ираклије у Евхаиту“ — and §4 refuses a translation day written onto an `undocumented` row, because it would bar a later reader from the principal day. **Here the principal day is already on this row**, read off this same book’s Julian 8 February, so nothing is barred and the second day is a note, which is what §4 asks for. The 8 June entry even sends the reader to the 8 February itself. THE GREEK ROW ALREADY SAID THE SAME THING FROM THE OTHER SIDE, AND THE TWO BOOKS NOW AGREE ON THE DIRECTION. The `greek` row’s note records saint.gr’s «το σεπτό σκήνωμά του μετετέθη, στις 8 Ιουνίου, από την Ηρακλεία … στα Ευχάιτα», adding that «the 8 June Greek day page was not read». **This book’s 8 June page has now been read and it gives the same translation in the same direction**, Herakleia to Euchaita — which is the opposite direction to the one the 8 February entry gave, Euchaita to Constantinople and the Blachernae. The 8 February note said neither was preferred and that stands; **what is new is that the disagreement is inside this one book, between its own two days.** AND THE BOOK GIVES THE WARRANT FOR THE PLACE: the translation was the saint’s own bequest at his passion to his servant, „Тело моје положи у Евхаити на имању мојих предака“ — lay my body at Euchaita on the estate of my forefathers — which is saint.gr’s «προγονικό κτήμα» in the saint’s own mouth. The servant is named Вар and gets no row: a servant carrying out a bequest is neither a martyrdom nor a kinship, and no calendar read for this corpus keeps him. A SECOND WONDER, FROM A NAMED WITNESS, AND IT IS THE OBJECT OF A WONDER AND NOT ITS SUBJECT. The entry gives Anastasius of Sinai’s record of the icon at Karsata near Damascus: a Saracen shot an arrow into the painted face of the saint on the wall, blood ran from the image, and soon the whole party of Saracens died there in the church; Anastasius says he was in that church himself and saw the face and the traces of the dried blood. **It is recorded in the life and no type was written on it**: the icon is the object of the wonder and the saint is not its narrated subject, which is the distinction this wave has been making since 24 May, and `wonderworker` was not added. A FIRST `sr` NAME FORM, WHICH THE 8 FEBRUARY READER DID NOT STORE. That reader quoted the 8 February heading into the row and stored no `sr` form at all, so the folder has carried `ro`, `el` and `ru` and no Serbian one. The 8 June heading prints the identical string, and «Теодор Стратилат» is stored now; `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`, so it raises no fold although five Стратилат folders exist. `dates`, `types`, `related` and `locations` all untouched: the 8 June entry gives no year, великомученик is the `great-martyr` already carried, and nobody in it has a folder. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

death.note: Two readings against one, and the interval is the disagreement. days.pravoslavie.ru for 8 февраля ст. ст.: «Вмч. Феодора Стратилата (319).»; the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 8 February: „Пострада свети Теодор 8. фебруара 319. године у три часа по подне.“; and saint.gr heads his page «Άγιος Θεόδωρος ο Στρατηλάτης (; - 320)» and dates the arrest to that year: «Όταν το 320 μ.Χ. ο Λικίνιος διέτριβε στη Νικομήδεια, άκουσε περί του Θεοδώρου ότι είναι Χριστιανός». The Russian figure was cited on this folder before this batch and had not been carried into the date, which stood at saint.gr's 320 alone. doxologia.ro gives no year.
